decisions.executionNote: Begin left approach to upright yellow bottle, slowly unfolding elbow-up from origin; right stays parked.
Align open left fingers with yellow bottle body, accounting for link6-to-finger offset; approach without closing yet.
Center on yellow body, close fully, and make a short test lift; retention must be checked visually.
Lift retained yellow bottle and translate left toward bin with gripper closed and continuous elbow-up configuration.
Yellow did not follow the test lift reliably. Reopen and advance fingers farther around its body, with smaller increments after IK guard.
Close around yellow at current contact and test a vertical lift, checking whether the bottle follows rather than pushing farther.
Yellow has fallen onto table rather than being retained. Reopen and lift into a downward approach for the lying bottle.
Continue upward and pitch down with halved increments after continuity rejection; keep fingers open.
Move above fallen yellow while pitching toward a top-down grasp; preserve elbow-up continuity.
Position open fingers above the lying yellow bottle for a near-vertical grasp, without descending into table.
Lower open left fingers onto the yellow bottle body and close fully; assess grasp before transporting.
Hold closed and test upward retention of yellow with a small sideways displacement.
Grasp missed; reopen and lower with a small forward correction so fingers surround the yellow body rather than its near edge.
Use wrist alignment to shift left across yellow body, close fully and test a short lift without pushing deeper.
Fingers appear above bottle rather than surrounding it. Reopen and descend 4 cm in small steps, then close at body height.
Contact prevented full descent. Maintain closed command and lift away gently to check if yellow is retained.
Recenter open grasp rightward and toward near side of yellow, accounting for finger-pad offset rather than camera center.
Bring the near yellow body between the open pads by backing toward the robot and shifting left; remain above table.
Adjust forward to place yellow body deeper between finger pads, with slight left correction and modest descent, then close.
Allow closure to settle and test lift of the yellow bottle.
Grasp missed the bottle end. Shift open fingers toward the middle of yellow body and descend cautiously.
Rotate open jaws perpendicular to lying bottle axis to avoid diagonal end grasps, keeping fingertips clear.
Align bottle centrally between perpendicular jaws and close at body depth.
Complete closure and lift while keeping the perpendicular grasp orientation; inspect retention.
Correct link6-to-pad offset: reopen, shift over bottle body and lower farther before attempting closure.
Center bottle between open pads using perpendicular correction, then hold closed long enough for closure.
Lift yellow now centered between pads; maintain fully closed command and inspect retention.
Yellow visibly follows gripper. Carry it leftward toward the bin while maintaining closed grasp.
Continue carrying retained yellow across the left table edge toward bin center.
Move bottle fully over bin interior and open left gripper for disposal.
Withdraw open left hand from released yellow and approach cream bottle. Begin slow right-arm approach toward green.
Approach cream from above with left; advance open right fingers toward green body. Yellow is visible in bin.
Lower and close left around cream, while right aligns open fingers around green without closing prematurely.
Finish left closure on cream, close right on green, and test retention with small vertical lifts.
Carry cream toward bin with closed left hand; green was not retained, so reopen right and center farther around its body.
Both bottles appear between pads. Carry cream toward bin and test green retention by lifting with right gripper closed.
Release cream over bin. Green did not remain between closed pads; reopen and recenter right fingers around its shifted body.
Cream released into bin. Withdraw left toward central receiving area; green has fallen, so raise and pitch right for a top grasp.
Prepare left hand for receiving while right advances above fallen green and pitches downward, staying in separate workspaces.
Continue right overhead alignment on green; orient open left hand toward central receiving region without crossing arms.
Lower open right pads around lying green body and close; left waits clear for handover.
Finish closing around green and lift to verify retention before moving to handover.
Green follows right gripper. Bring it toward center for handover, while left rotates receiving jaws perpendicular to bottle axis.
Bring retained green to center-right and complete left receiving orientation, keeping link6 positions on their respective sides.
Advance open left receiving pads around green's free body while right remains stationary and closed.
Adjust receiving hand lower and toward free neck to avoid right-hand contact; maintain right retention.
Lower receiving pads around green shoulder and close left while right still supports the bottle.
Test handover: settle left closure, release right support, then gently separate while checking whether left retains green.
Handover missed left pads; reopen and lower left to the settled green neck, with right withdrawing clear.
Reset clear receiving space. Reacquire green from above with right rather than closing against the table from the side.
Track the green bottle's new settled position and center open right pads over its body.
Lift open right fingers clear before recentering laterally over green, avoiding further side pushing.
Center right aperture on green using wrist view, then descend open without lateral contact.
Lift fully above green before lateral correction; previous low lateral adjustment pushed the bottle.
Green is centered in the right wrist view. Descend vertically around its body and close, without lateral pushing.
Settle green grasp and test lift. Reset left to an overhead receiving posture, keeping it safely clear.
Right closure was above green body. Reopen and descend deeper vertically; continue left overhead reset clear of bottle.
Center right pads leftward on green and close; orient left for an overhead receiving grasp.
Test green retention with a vertical lift while left finishes orienting toward a downward receiving grasp.
Green retained. Rotate its free neck toward the left workspace while carrying toward center, enabling an overhead handover without crossing arms.
Continue rotating retained green crosswise, with its neck approaching left-hand overhead aperture.
Rotate green the final quarter-turn toward the left aperture; keep right grasp closed until left contact is established.
Seat the left overhead pads around green neck/shoulder and close while right remains stationary and supports it.
Left missed the neck as green pivoted. Keep receiving pads open and bring the retained neck farther left and higher without crossing link6 positions.
Hold right stationary after guard; lower open left pads to the green neck's actual height and align across it.
Relieve hand-to-hand contact. Separate left while right levels the bottle to expose a clearer free neck for transfer.
Align left overhead aperture with the visible free green neck, moving toward the robot and slightly right; right supports stationary.
Lower left pads around exposed green shoulder and close while right continues holding; inspect before releasing support.
Direct handover remains unstable. Set green down at the center for a table-supported transfer, with left clear and open.
Withdraw open right hand upward and right to let green settle; position left safely above the transferred bottle.
Green now rests across center with neck in left workspace. Align left overhead grasp there; retract and reorient right for remaining blue bottle.
Track green's new near-table position with left pads above its neck. Move right above blue while restoring a downward grasp orientation, keeping arms separated.
